description: In front of you on the desk are an open notebook with a pen, a closed laptop with a small blue packet on it, a pile of clothes, and a cardboard box on the right. The left hand steadies the box while the right hand brings the box closer, then the right hand picks up the orange garment and stuffs it into the box, adds the green garment on top, drops the blue packet in, and places a white cup and a red-lidded container into the box before shifting the filled box toward the right edge of the desk.
